feeds.description: Featured articles covering Hialeah's Community, Businesses, Local issues, and other important topics from Hialeah and surrounding neighborhoods. Hy-Lo is a hyper-local news content platform focusing on the Black communities in South Florida. In 2018, We evolved to focus our coverage on Black and Brown Millennials in South Florida.
